title: Three Mornings and One Short Dial
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：hour　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hour 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the watchman ① kept the hour that no neighbour in the crossing would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the shift. The ② hour, meaning the moment itself and not the dial, ran three shifts and stayed unrecorded in the book; a hour, he said, is the only thing in a crossing that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ hour in that crossing had the same short dial beside it, and the ④ hour at the far railing, meaning the bell they kept for the children to hear and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hour, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the watchman said the recording is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hour was the whole of the matter, meaning the while and not the moment. The ⑥ hour, meaning the while and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; hour, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a moment and a while. He said the while is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ hour had become a line in a schedule, and the schedule had become an argument about the short dial. The ⑧ hour of the whole thing, the watchman wrote in February, was one crossing and three shifts of recording; hour, he said, is either the bell at the far railing or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hour I remember is the moment recorded in the schedule, which closed in 1971 and is still recorded as the quietest in the crossing. A ⑩ hour, my mother said in 1973, is the only moment that improves by being recorded; every hour, she said, is a while that has agreed to look like a moment. She said the while was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。

C. 固定搭配：keep the hour 守住这个钟点

answers.why: keep the hour 意为“守住这个钟点”，1964 年那位守夜人把路口里没有一位邻居肯记下的一个钟头做了一遍。
hour 意为“小时；钟头”，指那个时刻本身而不是表盘，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记下。
hour 意为“小时；钟头”，指路口里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一块小小的表盘。
hour 意为“小时；钟头”，指最远那道栏杆留给孩子们听的那一声那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hour 意为“片刻、一段时间”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片刻就是那件事的全部。
hour 意为“一段时间”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个时刻，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hour 意为“小时；钟头”，指排班表里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 1969 年这一个成了排班表里的一行。
hour 意为“时辰之事”，守夜人二月写道，整件事的小时之事是一处路口和三个班次的记下。
hour 意为“小时；钟头”，我记得的是排班表里记下过的那一个，1971 年排定了，至今仍被说成路口里最安静的一个。
hour 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，小时是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的时刻。
